message.content:
Below is a concise list of the long‑weekend holidays that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
A “long weekend” is defined as a public holiday that creates a three‑day weekend (i.e., the holiday falls on a Friday or Monday, or is observed on a Monday when it falls on a weekend).

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑Weekend Span | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | 1 Jan 2023 (Sunday) | 2 Jan 2023 (Monday) | 31 Dec 2022 – 2 Jan 2023 | Observed on Monday; long weekend includes 31 Dec 2022 (Saturday). |
| **Family Day** (Ontario, BC, NB, NS, PEI) | 20 Feb 2023 (Monday) | — | 18 Feb 2023 – 20 Feb 2023 | Long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, Saskatchewan, Manitoba) | 20 Mar 2023 (Monday) | — | 18 Mar 2023 – 20 Mar 2023 | Long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Family Day** (Newfoundland & Labrador) | 6 Feb 2023 (Monday) | — | 4 Feb 2023 – 6 Feb 2023 | Long weekend in NL. |
| **Good Friday** (most provinces) | 7 Apr 2023 (Friday) | — | 7 Apr 2023 – 9 Apr 2023 | Long weekend in those provinces. |
| **Victoria Day** | 22 May 2023 (Monday) | — | 20 May 2023 – 22 May 2023 | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **Canada Day** | 1 Jul 2023 (Saturday) | 3 Jul 2023 (Monday) | 1 Jul 2023 – 3 Jul 2023 | Observed on Monday; long weekend includes 1 Jul 2023 (Saturday). |
| **Labour Day** | 4 Sep 2023 (Monday) | — | 2 Sep 2023 – 4 Sep 2023 | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **Thanksgiving** | 9 Oct 2023 (Monday) | — | 7 Oct 2023 – 9 Oct 2023 | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **Remembrance Day** | 11 Nov 2023 (Monday) | — | 9 Nov 2023 – 11 Nov 2023 | Long weekend nationwide. |
| **Christmas Day** | 25 Dec 2023 (Monday) | — | 23 Dec 2023 – 25 Dec 2023 | Long weekend nationwide. |

### How to Use This Data

If you’re integrating this into a holiday‑planning app, you can store the above information in a simple JSON structure, e.g.:

```json
[
  {
    "holiday": "New Year’s Day",
    "date": "2023-01-01",
    "observed": "2023-01-02",
    "longWeekend": ["2022-12-31", "2023-01-01", "2023-01-02"]
  },
  {
    "holiday": "Family Day (Ontario, BC, NB, NS, PEI)",
    "date": "2023-02-20",
    "observed": null,
    "longWeekend": ["2023-02-18", "2023-02-19", "2023-02-20"]
  }
  /* …and so on for each entry */
]
```

Feel free to adjust the structure to match your app’s data model. If you need the data for a specific province only, filter the entries accordingly.
